verdict.rationale: Claude offers a full REST/Messages API with SDKs in multiple languages, a CLI, streaming, batch processing, token counting, and rate-limit/usage APIs, all of which support running headlessly in CI/automation pipelines without any UI. First-party docs explicitly frame the Messages API as suited to 'custom agent loops' and provide async batch processing and admin/usage APIs for programmatic pipelines. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of CI-specific integration (e.g., GitHub Actions example, headless invocation walkthrough) and no explicit mention of non-interactive/CI-mode flags for the `ant` CLI.
